programs.title: Zakhmi Insan (dub) (dass Tamil)
programs.desc: Antony falls in love with Rajeswari who belongs to an upper caste family. When her father kills her sister for marrying a man from the lower caste, she decides to elope with Antony.

programs.title: Buddha Mar Gaya
programs.desc: Laxmikant Kabadiya and his twin sister, Prerna, have made it to the top from the very bottom, and now -- as they are about to land their greatest windfall of all -- an untimely and messy family death spoils their plans.

programs.title: Hello Hum Lallan Bol Rahe Hain
programs.desc: Lallan, a security guard, loves Saroja, who is supposed to get married to an older man for money. However, while convincing her to change her mind, he finds out another shocking fact about her.

programs.title: Provoked
programs.desc: A Punjabi woman, who was abused by her husband for 10 years. After killing her husband in self-defense, Ahluwalia is imprisoned as those close to her fight to set her free.
